pre_exec: The parent must construct and verify exactly the eight v2 environment entries. __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING is not accepted as a parent/config entry. No inherited environment spread.
post_import: On Darwin only, frontend may additionally observe __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING. Check a bounded ASCII value (at most128bytes; no NUL/control characters). All eight required values still match exactly. Every other extra key remains rejected before main().
non_authority: Do not use this optional value for paths, executable choice, profile, provider, credentials, budgets or evidence identity. The frontend alone cannot prove origin; parent exact-env capture plus post-import capture supports this runtime observation.
offline_order: HOME, NODE_OPTIONS, PI_* and internal/credential entries are absent in the parent environment and at this pre-main check. main --offline may then set its documented internal PI flags; do not confuse later native mutation with inherited authority.
tests: Exact-eight pre-exec configuration accepted; config containing the extra key rejected by process boundary.
Darwin post-import exact-eight plus bounded optional key accepted.
Other extras, wrong required values, control characters or oversized optional values rejected before main/bridge.
auth_side_effect: Native AuthStorage reportedly created an empty auth.json in the owned synthetic profile. Record this expected ensure-exists side effect without inspecting, copying or exporting auth contents. It is not evidence that production OAuth has been provisioned.
scope: Environment validation repair within approved A2. No expanded model tools, credential access, native change or actual P0.
